name: @recoder/interop
description: Recoder's interop engine — fuses the A2A wire interoperability layer, the MCP host/registry with its authorize→risk→policy→audit gate, and the social/connector gateways into one owned, hostile-by-default control-plane library. Every inbound A2A envelope, MCP tool description, and connector message is untrusted until signature, identity, ownership, and policy are proven at the edge.
